name: drift-retrieval-dev
methodology: Prospective synthetic project baselines with explicit relevant requirement IDs, semantic paraphrases, and similar distractors.

requirements.title: Patient email login
requirements.description: Patients shall sign in using their email address and password.

requirements.title: Password recovery
requirements.description: Patients shall reset a forgotten password through an emailed recovery link.

requirements.title: Appointment booking
requirements.description: Patients shall book an available appointment with a clinician.

requirements.title: Appointment cancellation
requirements.description: Patients shall cancel an appointment until 24 hours before its scheduled time.

requirements.title: Invoice card payment
requirements.description: Patients shall pay an outstanding invoice online by card.

requirements.title: Clinic report export
requirements.description: Administrators shall export monthly clinic reports as CSV files.

requirements.title: Appointment notifications
requirements.description: Patients shall receive appointment booking, change, and cancellation emails.

requirements.title: Prescription documents
requirements.description: Patients shall download prescription PDF files from their visit history.

queries.message: Let patients recover forgotten passwords with an SMS one-time code too.
Change the appointment cancellation cutoff from 24 hours to 2 hours.
Drop card payments for invoices in the first release.
Send booking updates through WhatsApp as well as email.
Replace the monthly CSV with an interactive clinic analytics dashboard.
Move the prescription download link into the medical visit timeline.
Use magic links rather than passwords when a patient signs in.
When an appointment is booked, email the patient and let them add it to their calendar.

requirements.title: Customer authentication
requirements.description: Registered customers shall log in with email and password.

requirements.title: Guest checkout
requirements.description: Shoppers shall place an order without creating an account.

requirements.title: Product search
requirements.description: Shoppers shall search products by name, category, and brand.

requirements.title: Catalog filters
requirements.description: Shoppers shall filter product listings by price, rating, availability, and category.

requirements.title: Shopping cart
requirements.description: Shoppers shall add, remove, and change quantities of products in a cart.

requirements.title: Order payment
requirements.description: Customers shall pay for an order by card or bank transfer.

requirements.title: Refund processing
requirements.description: Support agents shall issue full or partial refunds to the original payment method.

requirements.title: Shipment tracking
requirements.description: Customers shall track shipped orders with a carrier tracking number.

requirements.title: Inventory availability
requirements.description: The storefront shall hide products that are out of stock.

requirements.title: Product reviews
requirements.description: Verified purchasers shall rate and review delivered products.

requirements.title: Promotion codes
requirements.description: Customers shall apply one valid promotion code during checkout.

requirements.title: Order emails
requirements.description: Customers shall receive email confirmations for orders, shipments, and refunds.

queries.message: Allow buyers to stack two discount coupons on one checkout.
Do not hide unavailable items; show them with a back-order date.
Add PayPal alongside card and bank transfer at payment.
Let anyone leave a star rating before their purchase is delivered.
Text the buyer when the parcel leaves the warehouse and include its tracking link.
Remove anonymous purchasing so every buyer must register.
Search should understand SKU identifiers in addition to product names.
A support agent needs to return money as store credit instead of to the original tender.

requirements.title: Member login
requirements.description: Workspace members shall authenticate using email and password.

requirements.title: Enterprise SSO
requirements.description: Enterprise workspaces shall authenticate members with SAML single sign-on.

requirements.title: Member invitations
requirements.description: Workspace owners shall invite new members by email.

requirements.title: Workspace roles
requirements.description: Owners shall assign owner, administrator, editor, or viewer roles.

requirements.title: Project creation
requirements.description: Members shall create projects within a workspace.

requirements.title: Project archive
requirements.description: Project administrators shall archive and restore projects.

requirements.title: Task management
requirements.description: Members shall create, assign, complete, and reopen project tasks.

requirements.title: Task comments
requirements.description: Members shall discuss a task in a threaded comment stream.

requirements.title: File attachments
requirements.description: Members shall attach files up to 25 MB to tasks.

requirements.title: Email notifications
requirements.description: Members shall receive email alerts for assignments, mentions, and due dates.

requirements.title: Notification digest
requirements.description: Members shall opt into a daily email digest of workspace activity.

requirements.title: Workspace search
requirements.description: Members shall search projects, tasks, and comments by keyword.

requirements.title: Task filters
requirements.description: Members shall filter tasks by assignee, status, label, and due date.

requirements.title: Project reports
requirements.description: Managers shall export project status reports as PDF files.

requirements.title: Portfolio dashboard
requirements.description: Managers shall view project health, deadlines, and workload charts.

requirements.title: Public API
requirements.description: Integrations shall read projects and tasks through authenticated REST endpoints.

requirements.title: Webhooks
requirements.description: Workspace owners shall register webhooks for task and project events.

requirements.title: Audit log
requirements.description: Administrators shall review security and configuration events for 90 days.

requirements.title: Subscription billing
requirements.description: Owners shall view invoices and pay the workspace subscription by card.

requirements.title: Data retention
requirements.description: Deleted workspace data shall be permanently erased after 30 days.

queries.message: Increase the maximum document attached to a task from 25 MB to 100 MB.
Post assignment and deadline alerts into Slack, not only email.
Allow security history to be searched for a full year rather than ninety days.
Add GraphQL access to projects and tasks alongside the existing REST interface.
When a task changes, send a signed callback to a customer URL.
Show workload grouped by department on the cross-project overview.
Support searching inside uploaded documents as well as task text.
Purge a closed workspace immediately instead of retaining deleted data for thirty days.
